source_review.notes: Checked all twelve references for identity, authorship, date, edition, publisher or venue, and relevant scope. Official ISO records support the 2022 architecture-description standard and the July 2019 architecture-evaluation standard; ISO confirmed the latter in 2025 and records a revision under development. Current official SEI records support ATAM and CBAM; the publisher record supports the February 2026 second edition of Designing Data-Intensive Applications; and the DOI record supports the Parnas paper. Textbook and decision-analysis references are used for durable foundations. Current-status claims are dated, and no source is represented as certification, a context-free ranking rule, or universal architectural evidence.
